description: This file defines the TwitterOAuth class, a PHP library for handling OAuth authentication with Twitter's REST API, including methods for obtaining request tokens, access tokens, and making signed API requests.

classes.name: TwitterOAuth
classes.description: A PHP class for handling OAuth authentication with Twitter's API, including token management and request signing.

methods.name: accessTokenURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for obtaining an access token.

methods.name: authenticateURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for Twitter OAuth authentication.

methods.name: authorizeURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for OAuth authorization.

methods.name: requestTokenURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for requesting a request token.

methods.name: lastStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the last HTTP status code received.

methods.name: lastAPICall
methods.description: Returns the last API call made.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for TwitterOAuth, initializes OAuth consumer and token.

methods.name: getRequestToken
methods.description: Obtains a request token from Twitter.

methods.name: getAuthorizeURL
methods.description: Generates the URL for user authorization.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Exchanges a request token and verifier for an access token.

methods.name: getXAuthToken
methods.description: Performs a one-time exchange of username and password for an access token.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the Twitter API.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the Twitter API.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the Twitter API.

methods.name: oAuthRequest
methods.description: Prepares and signs an OAuth API request.

methods.name: http
methods.description: Executes an HTTP request using cURL.
